result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order report no longer counts cancelled purchase orders. I added `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the subquery in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (around line 6517). I also changed the Javadoc to say "non-cancelled".

Reps with no purchase orders in the period are still listed with 0, and the ordering is unchanged. The full `mvn -q -o test` run passes after the change. I didn't add a test for the cancelled case, so your Anna/Bob example isn't covered by a test.
